groups.note: Language Requirement: third-year competency in Russian or another language of Eastern Europe or Eurasia. Language courses cannot count toward the 24 hour core, but those taken beyond the third-year requirement can count as electives. Approved language courses that focus on literature (see list maintained by REEEC) may also meet the core or elective requirement.
